ambiguity: You asked for totals per calendar day against the calendar our reports use, without saying which calendar that is.

facts.fact: A day means a New York calendar day, America/New_York, not a UTC day. Finance reconciles against the New York close, so an event at 22:30 local belongs to that local date even though its UTC date is the next one.
The order of the keys does not matter.
Days with no events can simply be absent.

stonewall: No strong view on that one - use your judgement.
